description: This Java class, GetSortBsonVisitor, is part of a package related to expression visitors for sorting in a persistence layer. It constructs MongoDB BSON sort specifications from complex query expressions, handles projections and sorting values, and implements the SortFieldExpressionVisitor interface to translate sort fields into MongoDB sort keys.

classes.name: GetSortBsonVisitor
classes.description: A final class implementing SortFieldExpressionVisitor to convert sort field expressions into BSON sort specifications for MongoDB.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method that creates a list of BSON sort specifications from a sort expression and direction.

methods.name: projections
methods.description: Generates a MongoDB Document representing the projection of sort keys based on a list of sort options.

methods.name: sortValuesAsArray
methods.description: Converts a document of sort keys into a JSON array of their corresponding values.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Translates a SortFieldExpression into a string path suitable for sorting.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Implements visitor method to generate sort key for attribute based on a key.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Implements visitor method to generate sort key for feature ID and property.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Handles simple field names, prefixing with slash if necessary, for sorting.
